title: Debiasing Methods for Fairer Neural Models in Vision and Language Research: A Survey
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on debiasing methods for fairness concerning attributes such as race, gender, and age in vision and language models.
